1-hit.result:
Context window = max text a language model can see at once when it generates a reply. Measured in tokens, which are word pieces, roughly 3/4 of a word each.

Window holds everything: system prompt, chat history, pasted files, tool results, and the reply being written. Model has no memory outside it. Text that falls outside window is invisible to the model.

Bigger window means longer documents and chats fit. Cost also rises: more compute, more latency, more money. Quality can drop too. Models sometimes miss details buried in the middle of very long input.

When the window fills, apps must act. Common fixes:
- Truncate old messages.
- Summarize earlier turns.
- Retrieve only relevant passages, as in RAG.

Window size differs per model. Check the model's docs for the exact limit.
